reason: We have already decided to go into the new market and I have no pipeline there, and fairs plus my network won't fill it fast enough. The free 15-company list costs me one call, the first 3 meetings are free and the cap is EUR 900, so I would take the free step and sign the pilot in Relationship mode if the list looks right.
objection: Our name is our business in this trade. If some agency blasts mass emails under my company's name or messes up GDPR in a new country, I'm the one who pays for it, and I get three or four pitches a week from agencies promising meetings that turn out to be junk.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies on the free list are ones I already know or obviously wrong for us, or if they push me toward Volume mode, I walk away.
